title: lactuca versicolor
intro: Lactuca versicolor, commonly known as American wild lettuce, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion-like genus Lactuca. It is used for its medicinal and culinary properties, with health benefits including the potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The therapeutic actions of Lactuca versicolor include its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca versicolor include lactucarium, a mixture of sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
